scope: Finite exact-CAD operations, nominal flat land, guide contact and first-layer connectivity. Separate analytical release estimate. No holding-force or physical acceptance claim.

first_layer_connectivity.scope: Exact 0.002mm layer slabs at the flat retaining features. Connectivity does not qualify overhang/bridge deposition.

analytical_release.scope: Linear rectangular cantilever, fixed root and pad point load with unloaded overhang. No contact, printed material calibration, insertion or holding-force prediction.
analytical_release.material_assumptions: Effective isotropic PETG stiffness bracket only; neither strength nor printed anisotropy is calibrated.

liner_compatibility: Not established; existing liner is M1-specific.
manufacturing_status: Unqualified pending actual slice and retaining-feature toolpath inspection.
limitations: Guide-clear angular motion excludes hooks and is not equilibrium or stiffness; hook obstruction is reported separately.
Offsets test X or Y separately, avoiding assertion that combined corner translations are guide-admissible.
Negative cap Z offsets test leaf clearance only; the circumferential seat separately blocks actual negative whole-cap motion.
Seated leaf recovery is a kinematic return envelope, not material recovery or a simulated snap closure.
Actual holding requires deformable eccentric loading and receiver/full-shell contact evidence; planar overlap is insufficient.

baseline_m1_guide_comparison.scope: Authoritative full-size M1 and M2B rigid guide/seat contact. Both designs rotate about the seam center with zero cap-center translation; this is a prescribed seam-pivot bound, not the freely floating optimum rotation or angular stiffness.

guide_pose_scope: Both designs rotate about seam center with zero cap-center translation. This is a prescribed seam-pivot bound, not freely floating optimum angle, stiffness or equilibrium.

producer_association_review.mode: reviewed retained evidence; no new CAD computation
producer_association_review.basis: Authoritative M1/M2B geometry hashes are unchanged. Reviewed producer changes add script identity and prevent supplemental runs from silently refreshing changed producer identity. Retained guide samples remain valid, including earlier .9 mm primary samples also retained in same-pose comparison. Verification now requires finite contact brackets and complete declared pose coverage.
